description: The agent must: (1) Locate the workflow hardening audit skill under skills/github-actions-workflow-hardening-audit/scripts/workflow-hardening-audit.sh. (2) Invoke it with OUTPUT_FORMAT=json, REQUIRE_CONCURRENCY=1 (non-default, must read docs), WARN_SCORE=2, CRITICAL_SCORE=5 (non-default thresholds), EVENT_EXCLUDE='release' (to drop the release.yml pipeline from scope), ALLOW_REF_REGEX='@v4' (to whitelist the company-approved v4 tags — a non-obvious bespoke param), FAIL_ON_CRITICAL=1, and WORKFLOW_GLOB='.github/workflows/*.y*ml'. (3) Redirect the JSON stdout into audit-report.json at the workspace root. The proprietary traps: REQUIRE_CONCURRENCY is off by default and must be explicitly enabled; ALLOW_REF_REGEX is an obscure whitelist parameter that prevents over-flagging; the WARN_SCORE/CRITICAL_SCORE thresholds must be set to non-default values; EVENT_EXCLUDE must be applied to remove release-triggered workflows. Any agent relying on general knowledge will miss at least two of these parameters and produce an incorrect or incomplete report.
